The '''Patitites''', also known as the '''Pattuna''', were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of diminutive [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Patitites were short [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]<ref name="ND" /> native from the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Enc P" /> from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Found on the average heigth of about 0.4 meters,<ref name="Enc P" /> they had skin [[Color/Legends|color]] varying from blue, green and purple. The shape of the heads were different between males and females.<ref name="ND" />

==Society and culture==
Though technologically primitive, Patitites were bright-minded and did had a grasp on machinery.<ref name="Enc P" /> They carried powered<ref name="ND" /> ion<ref name=":1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> [[Staff/Legends|polearms]] and were able to assist in repairing a downed [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing bomber]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ND" /> They were socially primitive, living in a tyrannical [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictatorship]] where all Patitites are subservient to their ruler.<ref name="Enc P" /> They were puzzled about [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]].<ref name=":1" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Patitites were ruled by the dictator [[Hay-Zu/Legends|Hay-Zu]]. Hay-Zu was accidentally killed by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]<ref name="ND" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref>{{TCWdates|406}}</ref> when the latter stepped on [[Gender/Legends|him]],<ref name="ND" /> greatly unsettling Patitite society.<ref name="Enc P" /> The Patitites then asked C-3PO to be their new leader. He refused and instead helped them establish their [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]] and elect their new leader. As the droids left, fighting broke out amongst them pertaining to who would be the leader,<ref name="ND" /> erupting in civil war<ref name=":0">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep406|text="Nomad Droids" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> that undoubtedly doomed their society to generations of turmoil and strife.<ref name="Enc P" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Patitites were created as a reference to the [[Brownie]]s, a similarly-sized species from [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[1988]] [[Wikipedia:Sword and sorcery|sword and sorcery]] film [[Willow (film)|''Willow'']].<ref name=":0" /> [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] counts himself a large fan of the film, and he also saw to it that the voices of the Patitite characters were reminiscent of those of the Brownies. However, in an effort to somewhat distinguish them from their source material, he gave the Patitites radically different colorations than the [[Human/Legends|Human]]-looking Brownies.<ref name="Willow">{{SW|url=video/questions-answered-nass-orphne-and-willow-the-clone-wars|text=Questions Answered: Nass, Orphne and Willow}}</ref>
